reforms.description: The Vocational Training Programme was established to provide unskilled workers with opportunities to acquire more qualified jobs, addressing structural unemployment in Canada.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: By enhancing the skills of the workforce, the programme aims to reduce unemployment and improve productivity, contributing positively to economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: Budget allocations for this purpose are rising sharply.
reforms.importance_rationale: The programme represents a significant effort to address unemployment through skill development, which is crucial for enhancing the employability of workers.
reforms.source_quote: Recognition of the structural aspects of unemployment led to the vote, in 1960, of a Vocational Training Programme designed to give unskilled workers the opportunity to take on more qualified jobs.
